# P35.37 — figure → evidence pointers

**Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/316_P35.37__figure-to-evidence-pointers.md`
(manifest row **316**, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B — `R11-K13-TX-09`).
Invoked `live_verification=false` — committed code + tests only; **no
deploy, no production mutation, no publication/release gate, no
connector or registry flip, no merge to main**. Requirement stamps:
**SIG-TRANSP-013** (*Figure-to-evidence pointers* — §56.10 names this
row `Owner:`) · cited: **SIG-UI-035** (release-pinned addressing),
**SIG-UI-044** (the how-we-know-this module), **UXR-34** (K13 §7 W1 —
one `figures[]` registry per page, unique ids, resolvable
breakdowns), **DR-C3-01 / DR-C3-03** (the evaluation numbers move
into the release), **PKG-10** (per-source provenance slices),
**F-102** (the honesty floor — an unreachable target is a named
absence, never a fabricated link). **Base:**
`r11/P35.36-statements-files-and-provenance-panel-v2` · **Gate:**
none — the plan cell carries no gate.

## The problem

J3 §5.4's contract: every material number on the public surface
should render as `<Figure value=… artifact=… pointer=… definition=…
href=…>` — a manifest-artifact path, a JSON pointer into it, a
definition anchor, and a visible evidence link. Before this row the
pages rendered bare numerals: home headline counts, coverage metrics
and density tiles, dossier figures/rows/notes, freshness tables, the
evaluation metrics (hard-coded TS constants), and the operator
basis sentence all carried numbers a reader could not trace.

## What landed

- **`web/src/lib/figures.ts`** — the figure contract. `FigureSpec`
  carries J3 §5.4's five fields verbatim plus the UXR-34 registry
  bookkeeping (`id`, `class`, `targets`, `breakdown`). Each
  `FigureTarget` is a resolvable `href` XOR a named `absent` —
  never both, never neither, never a dead link; the per-class
  builders resolve the J3 link-target table (headline → definition
  anchor + artifact + downloadable file; dossier → record list +
  provenance + per-source slices; per-source → `/sources/<id>/`
  coverage; freshness → the run row; contradictions → records;
  evaluation → the artifact itself), with P36.48/P36.46/not-yet-
  bound-release targets carried as named absences.
  `assertFigureSpec`/`defineFigures` fail the build on a non-slug
  id, a non-manifest-listed artifact, a non-`/` pointer, a missing
  definition/source/breakdown, or a malformed target.
- **`web/src/components/Figure.astro`** — the one renderer every
  material number goes through: `data-figure-id`, `data-artifact`,
  `data-pointer`, `data-breakdown`, `data-figure-value`,
  `id="fig-<id>"` (every breakdown resolves in-page), a visible
  "definition" + "source" link line, and the `<!-- sig-figure -->`
  region bounds the bare-numeral check reads.
- **`web/src/lib/dossier-figures.ts`** — the dossier registry:
  banner unknown-count, section figures, numeral-bearing rows
  (the numeral may live in the value OR a note — the "…not
  'currently shares with 147'" caveat is a figure too),
  notice-window days, and numeral-bearing gap labels (per render
  variant so the summary + section copies never collide). Pointers
  index the RAW artifact record (`/<index>/sections/…`), never the
  filtered render index; `DossierSection` wraps the whole row cell,
  preserving the `<details>` reconciliation.
- **`web/src/lib/figure-artifacts.json`** — the committed manifest
  allow-list the fixtures-mode check verifies against (export mode
  verifies against the real `manifest.json`).
- **`web/scripts/check-figures.mjs`** — the rendered-output gate
  wired into `npm run check` (`check:figures`): every figure region
  on the named page classes (home, dossier, coverage, freshness,
  sources, data, status) must carry a manifest-listed
  `data-artifact`, a JSON `data-pointer`, a resolvable
  `data-breakdown`, a unique `data-figure-id`, and a visible source
  link; after removing every figure region, a material numeral in
  `<main>` fails the build — incidental citations (RFC ids, statute
  titles, HTTP status codes) are recorded exemptions in
  `figure-numerals-allowlist.json` (file + token + count + reason),
  never silent. Exit 3 when vacuous.
- **`web/src/pages/artifact/[...path].json.ts`** — the static
  `/artifact/<export-path>.json` route: each figure's
  downloadable/recomputable evidence file, served fail-closed
  through `getReleaseArtifactPayload()` — no arbitrary path reads.
- **New release artifacts** — `web/sources.json`
  (`sig.source-licence-table/1`, `exports/source_licences.py`) and
  `web/evaluation.json` (`sig.resolution-eval/1`, DR-C3-03): the
  exporter emits both into the extended manifest; the data layer
  reads them through the same seam in both modes, so the
  methodology eval and the source-licence figures come from
  release bytes, never constants.
- **Converged renderers** — dossier pages + print exports,
  coverage metrics (incl. the density-bin tiles, K12b NEW-14),
  freshness rows, home headline counts, status, methodology eval
  metrics, sources (incl. the operator basis sentence's ≈8,088 as
  a `basis-rows` figure), corrections and research-queue
  provenance, and the shared `HowWeKnowThis` module (a
  numeral-bearing provenance denominator gets its own figure —
  surfaced by the export-mode check).
- **Containment honoured** — new links go through `withBase()`;
  the new root-absolute literals are JSON pointers, provenance
  pointer bases and canonical-path props — 26 recorded exemptions
  in `root-absolute-paths-baseline.json` (the check counts 160
  sites, unchanged).
